name: Kokoro TTS
summary: Ultra-lightweight 82M-parameter Apache-2.0 open-weight TTS model delivering shockingly natural, expressive real-time voice synthesis locally.
ranking_rationale: Tiny 82M footprint runs faster than real-time even on CPU or low-VRAM alongside an LLM, weighed against no zero-shot 5-second voice cloning out of the box — uses curated/blended voice packs.

pricing.notes: Pricing and promos change frequently; verify directly at official checkout.

pros: Tiny 82M footprint runs faster than real-time even on CPU or low-VRAM alongside an LLM
Apache-2.0 permissive license with expressive voice blending ideal for SillyTavern voice replies
cons: No zero-shot 5-second voice cloning out of the box (uses curated/blended voice packs)
Limited language set compared with massive cloud APIs
